_sources._note: JSON has no comment syntax, so every emission/energy factor's provenance lives here. Edit the numbers above; keep these citations in sync. All factors are independently verifiable from the cited EPA documents.
_sources.electricity_kgCO2e_per_kWh: eGRID2022 RMPA (WECC Rockies) subregion CO2e total output emission rate = 1,131.7 lb CO2e/MWh. Converted: 1131.7 lb/MWh x 0.45359237 kg/lb / 1000 kWh/MWh = 0.5133 kg CO2e/kWh. (CO2-only rate is 1,124.9 lb/MWh = 0.5103 kg/kWh.) Source: EPA eGRID2022 Summary Tables, Table 1 'Subregion Output Emission Rates' (released Jan 2024). VERIFY your utility maps to the RMPA subregion before trusting this; if you are on Xcel/Public Service Co of Colorado most of Colorado is RMPA, but confirm.
_sources.natural_gas_kgCO2_per_therm: 0.0053 metric tons CO2 per therm = 5.30 kg CO2/therm. CO2 only; adding CH4 + N2O raises it < 0.5%. Source: EPA Greenhouse Gas Equivalencies Calculator - Calculations and References (2025), 'therms of natural gas' factor, derived from 14.43 MMT C/QBtu carbon coefficient at 100% oxidation. Cross-check: EPA GHG Emission Factors Hub 2025, Stationary Combustion (53.06 kg CO2/mmBtu x 0.1 mmBtu/therm = 5.31).
_sources.propane_kgCO2_per_gal: 5.72 kg CO2 per gallon (CO2 only). Source: EPA GHG Emission Factors Hub 2025 (Jan 2025), Table 1 Stationary Combustion, Propane. VERIFY against the current Hub spreadsheet; the EPA Equivalencies cylinder-basis figure derives a slightly higher number, so this is the inventory-grade Stationary Combustion value.
_sources.gasoline_kgCO2_per_gal: 8.887 kg CO2 per gallon (8,887 g CO2/gal). Source: EPA Greenhouse Gas Equivalencies Calculator - Calculations and References (2025); originates from the EPA/DOT joint National Program rulemaking (May 7, 2010), IPCC 2006 method, assuming 100% oxidation of carbon to CO2.
_sources.energy_content_kbtu: Higher-heating-value energy content used for site EUI (kBtu/sqft/yr). electricity 3.412 kBtu/kWh (1 kWh = 3,412 Btu). natural_gas 100 kBtu/therm (1 therm = 100,000 Btu, by definition). propane 91.452 kBtu/gal (EPA: ~91,452 Btu/gal HHV). Site EUI per ENERGY STAR convention counts delivered site energy, not source energy.
